svg.aria-label: I design and build business software end to end, from the database and APIs to the web and mobile screens people use every day. My work sits where sales, production and warehouse operations meet: CRM, ERP, MES and WMS systems, the integrations that keep them in sync, and AI-powered tools that take repetitive work off people's plates.
